name: Florianópolis
registryBasis: Florianópolis municipal materials describe GeoFloripa as the city’s internal multipurpose territorial-cadastre system and GeoPortal as the public IDE with interactive maps, geoservices, metadata, and downloads. The official city service for georeferencing lots confirms the municipal lot-cartography workflow.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: Official GeoPortal documentation publishes the GeoFloripa GeoServer WMS endpoint and identifies the public GeoPortal as a source of downloadable map layers. Anonymous attempts to load WMS GetCapabilities and a WFS DescribeFeatureType request to candidate type Geoportal:lotes_pgv_2023 did not return an HTTP response: the default shell attempt failed DNS resolution and the network-enabled retry timed out after 25 seconds. The web fetcher also marked the endpoint inaccessible. Thus the WMS URL is documented, but layer capabilities, WFS type, DescribeFeatureType fields, CRS, stable parcel ID, and any server-side propertyName allowlist remain unverified. A non-official technical page names lotes_pgv_2023 and indicates cadastral/tax attributes may be present; it is only a lead, not official schema evidence. No GetFeature/identify request or geometry download was made.
scopeLimits: Florianópolis public GeoPortal and documented GeoServer WMS are confirmed, but the service did not return capabilities/DescribeFeatureType from this environment. No safe parcel-feature response or representative complete polygon has been verified.
remainingUncertainty: A WFS/OGC parcel layer may be published, but the candidate layer name and fields are not officially verified here; CRS, stable ID, and a propertyName geometry/ID-only allowlist remain unknown. No feature request was made.
